segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: Hi, this is Megan at Westbrook Supply. I need to add three users to our account before our training tomorrow morning.

segments.speaker: Agent
segments.text: Yeah, I can help with that. Can you confirm the account name and the admin email you're using?

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: Sure, account is Westbrook Supply Group, and the admin email is megan.cho@westbrooksupply.com.

segments.speaker: Agent
segments.text: Thanks. I found the account in the admin console. You currently have 42 active seats and your plan includes up to 50, so adding three won't change billing. What are the new users' names and emails?

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: It's Daniel Price, daniel.price@westbrooksupply.com; Priya Shah, priya.shah@westbrooksupply.com; and Luis Romero, luis.romero@westbrooksupply.com.

segments.speaker: Agent
segments.text: Got it. Should they have the standard user role, same as your operations team?

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: Yes, standard user is fine. They just need access to the order dashboard and reports.

segments.speaker: Agent
segments.text: Okay, I've added all three and assigned them to the Operations group, which includes those permissions. Invitation emails are going out now.

segments.speaker: Agent
segments.text: They expire after seven days, so through July 15. If anyone misses it, you can resend from Users in the admin console, or just reply to ticket 184732 and we can resend them.

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: Great, that covers it. Thanks for the quick help.

segments.speaker: Agent
segments.text: You're welcome. I'll close this out with a note that the three seats were added and no billing change was needed.
